note: Outside on everything the ICP is actually built to screen for. A 20-year-old bar back is not a business owner, physician or equivalent, and his budget is 'pretty much free, almost', so successful and income both fail outright. Health is not his neglected area either — it is the one thing he is doing well, at 5'10" and 150 lb with visible abs, no injuries and two months of consistent kettlebell training. The two matches are real but weak: he genuinely wants good-to-great rather than rescue, and he is emphatically not the deconditioned profile the ICP excludes. The useful observation for the rollup is about the funnel rather than the prospect. He arrived through the same free Instagram content as several better-qualified prospects in this batch, which means top-of-funnel is selecting on interest in kettlebells and not on any of the five criteria — and the only thing that catches it is a closer asking the budget question eight minutes in.
